market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a hawkish Fed pivot with rate-hike odds rising post-162K jobs print. Oil at $97 and diesel at record highs create inflationary pressure that complicates the rate path. Expect volatility: Dow's 600-point intraday gain reversed into broader losses. Bond yields remain the dominant macro variable. Crypto choppy on hawkish Fed. Gold supported by geopolitical risk. 1-3 month outlook: range-bound equities, rising yields, elevated energy.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (GPT-6, Soitec, Nvidia) provides structural equity support through 2027-28. EM rotation and IPO pipeline (Dangote, Yunxi) offer diversification. Credit/fintech disruption (Pulte, Revolut, CLARITY Act) reshapes financials over 12+ months. Energy transition (ChargePoint, JinkoSolar) and senior housing (LTC) are secular themes. Risk: prolonged high-rate environment compressing multiples and consumer spending. 6-12 month outlook: selective equity outperformance in AI, energy, EM; underperformance in staples and rate-sensitive REITs.
